v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Heródes enim ténuit * et ligávit Ioánnem et pósuit in cárcerem propter Herodíadem.
text.en: For Herod had laid hold upon John, * and bound him, and put him in prison, for Herodias' sake.

text.la: Dómine mi rex, * da mihi in disco caput Ioánnis Baptístæ.
text.en: O Lord my King, * give me in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

text.la: Puéllæ saltánti * imperávit mater: Nihil áliud petas, nisi caput Ioánnis.
text.en: The damsel danced, * and her mother charged her, saying: See thou ask nothing, but only the head of John.

text.la: Arguébat * Heródem Ioánnes propter Herodíadem, quam túlerat fratri suo Philíppo uxórem.
text.en: John had rebuked Herod for Herodias' sake, * his brother Philip's wife, for he had taken her.

text.la: Da mihi in disco * caput Ioánnis Baptístæ. Et contristátus est rex propter iusiurándum.
text.en: Give me in a charger the head of John the Baptist. * And the King was sorry, for his oath's sake.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Misso Heródes * spiculatóre, præcépit amputári caput Ioánnis in cárcere. Quo audíto, discípuli eius venérunt, et tulérunt corpus eius, et posuérunt illud in monuménto.
text.en: Herod sent * an executioner, and commanded that John's head should be cut off in the prison. And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

text.la: Sancti Ioánnis Baptístæ Præcursóris et Mártyris tui, quǽsumus, Dómine, veneránda festívitas: salutáris auxílii nobis præstet efféctum:
text.en: Lord, we beseech thee, that the keeping of this honourable feastday in memory of the holy Baptist John, thy Fore-runner, and thy Martyr, may be a mean to draw upon us the effectual outpouring of thy saving help.

text.la: Date ei de fructu mánuum suárum, et laudent eam in portis ópera eius.
text.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her own works praise her in the gates.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Deus, qui inter cétera poténtiæ tuæ mirácula étiam in sexu frágili victóriam martýrii contulísti: concéde propítius; ut, qui beátæ Sabínæ Mártyris tuæ natalícia cólimus, per eius ad te exémpla gradiámur.
text.en: O God, Who, amidst the wondrous work of thy divine power, dost make even weak women to be more than conquerors in the uplifting of their testimony, mercifully grant unto all us which do keep the birthday of thy blessed witness Sabina, grace to follow her steps toward thee.
